questions.text: What is the name of the underwater kingdom ruled by King Triton in a classic Disney animated film?

questions.text: Which 1930s singer voiced the title character in Disney's first full-length animated feature film?
questions.explanation: Walt Disney personally selected Adriana Caselotti to voice Snow White in 1937's Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, making her the first feature-length animated film voice actress.

questions.text: What is the exact runtime, in minutes, of Disney's first full-length animated feature film?
questions.explanation: This question targets a specific, non-obvious fact about Disney's first full-length animated feature, Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, which is 83 minutes long. This is a moderate detail that a fan would likely know, exploring the specific angle of numbers.

questions.text: What was the title of the first Disney animated feature film?
options: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
questions.explanation: The first Disney animated feature film was Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, released in 1937.

questions.text: Which Disney animated feature was the first to be released after the death of Walt Disney?
questions.explanation: The first full-length animated feature film released after Walt Disney's death was The Jungle Book (1967), which premiered about ten months after he passed away in December 1966.

questions.text: By what deadline must the Beast break the spell in Disney's 'Beauty and the Beast'?
options: Before the winter solstice of that year
Before three full moons have passed
Before the last petal of an enchanted rose falls
Before the sun sets on his twenty-first birthday
questions.explanation: The curse in Disney's 'Beauty and the Beast' requires the Beast to learn to love and be loved in return before the last petal of an enchanted rose falls; if he fails, he remains a beast forever.

questions.text: Which performer provided the voice for the title character in Walt Disney's first full-length animated feature film?
questions.explanation: Adriana Caselotti provided the speaking and singing voice for Snow White in Disney's first animated feature, 'Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs' (1937).

questions.text: Which Disney animated classic includes the phrase 'Hakuna Matata'?
questions.explanation: The question asks which Disney animated film features the line 'Hakuna Matata,' which is a famous quote from The Lion King.

questions.text: Which animator is credited as the sole director of Disney's 1940 film 'Fantasia'?
options: None; Walt Disney oversaw the film without a single credited director
questions.explanation: Which animator is credited as the sole director of Disney's 1940 film 'Fantasia'? None — the film had no single director; it was overseen by Walt Disney himself with multiple sequence directors.
